segments: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set [him] in safety [from him that] puffeth at him. {puffeth...: or, would ensnare him}

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
segments: The words of the LORD [are] pure words: [as] silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
